description: General Corporate BS presentation skeleton inspired by the supplied AEVA presentation example; US-GAAP concepts are co-located, provisional, and not implied arithmetic. Expanded with candidate classifications from user unmapped list. Review required before production use.

metadata_notes.period_and_unit: Period and unit types checked against the 2026 taxonomy. Historical filings require their own taxonomy context.
metadata_notes.contra: Intrinsic deduction balances; does not prescribe fact signs.
metadata_notes.unmapped_placeholders: Original concept-free placeholders retained outside the skeleton tree; no mapped concepts were removed.
